file_spec.value: Two passport photographs required, in colour (not black & white).

ears_visibility.value: Both ears must be visible; ears must not be covered.

face_visibility.value: Forehead must not be covered; shoulders square to the camera; no visible shadow.

accessories.value: No earrings for men; no eyebrow, chin, or nose rings for any applicant.

ears.en: Both ears must be visible; ears must not be covered.
ears.ko: 양쪽 귀가 보여야 하며, 귀를 가리면 안 됨.
ears.ja: 両耳が見える状態にし、耳を隠さないこと。

face_visibility.en: Forehead must not be covered; shoulders square to the camera; no visible shadow.
face_visibility.ko: 이마를 가리면 안 되며, 어깨는 카메라를 정면으로 향하고 그림자가 보이지 않아야 함.
face_visibility.ja: 額を隠さず、肩はカメラに対して正面を向け、影が見えないようにすること。

headwear.ko: 모자 등 머리 장식 착용 금지.
headwear.ja: 帽子などの被り物は禁止。

accessories.en: No earrings for men; no eyebrow, chin, or nose rings for any applicant.
accessories.ko: 남성은 귀걸이 금지, 모든 신청자는 눈썹·턱·코 피어싱(링) 금지.
accessories.ja: 男性はピアス（イヤリング）禁止。全申請者は眉・あご・鼻のピアス（リング）禁止。

cross_verification.note_en: Source is the Embassy of Namibia in Sweden's official 'requirements for new passport' page, which mirrors Ministry of Home Affairs and Immigration (MHA) rules. MHA's own domestic site (mha.gov.na/passports-general-information) only states 'clear background', consistent with but less specific than the embassy's 'white background'. No official source found stating exact photo size (mm) or head-height measurement for the passport (as opposed to the visa, where an official visa application form gives 37×52mm — see na-visa).
